entries.subject: Published model dimensions
entries.finding: The paper’s stated model dimensions are used through the existing ellipsoid recipe.

entries.subject: JWST/NIRSpec spectrum of 2003 AZ84 as surface data
entries.finding: The [JWST/NIRSpec spectrum of 2003 AZ84](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202346998) explicitly treats the target as spatially unresolved. A spectrum cannot become registered surface texels.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved surface map or registered imaging of this object is released.
